page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7nex.32xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose server instance running on a KVM hypervisor platform. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.7 GHz, the instance delivers 128 dedicated vCPUs alongside 512.0 GB of RAM. This configuration maintains a 1:4 resource allocation ratio of 4.0 GB of system memory per vCPU. The instance is not equipped with local storage disks or GPU hardware acceleration.

A primary specification of the ecs.g7nex.32xlarge is its baseline network throughput of 160 Gbps. Because local disk storage is omitted, all persistence requires remote network-attached block storage. The high network bandwidth offset balances data transport constraints when interacting with cloud storage volumes or communicating within distributed host networks.

The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM balance positions this host for large enterprise applications and high-density container environments. Primary recommended workloads include microservice backends, enterprise application servers, distributed data transformation pipelines, and parallel compute nodes that require substantial network throughput.

To support heavy network traffic and remote storage I/O, the instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 160 Gbps. Its high vCPU density combined with significant network capability makes the ecs.g7nex.32xlarge effective for large-scale enterprise microservices, memory-conscious data pipelines, backend application clusters, and web serving workloads needing strong multi-core parallelism.
